description: This file defines the CameraCaptureManager class, which manages camera operations such as listing camera devices, capturing high-quality images, recording video clips, and handling camera permissions within an Android application using CameraX API and Kotlin coroutines.

classes.name: CameraCaptureManager
classes.description: Main class managing camera operations, permissions, device listing, image capture, and video recording for an Android application using CameraX.

classes.name: CameraCaptureManager.Payload
classes.description: Data class representing the payload containing JPEG image data and related info.

classes.name: CameraCaptureManager.FilePayload
classes.description: Data class representing video clip file information, including file reference, duration, and audio presence.

classes.name: CameraCaptureManager.CameraDeviceInfo
classes.description: Data class defining details about a camera device such as id, name, position, and device type.

methods.name: attachLifecycleOwner
methods.description: Associates a LifecycleOwner to manage camera lifecycle.

methods.name: attachPermissionRequester
methods.description: Attaches a PermissionRequester to handle permission requests.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Returns a list of available camera devices with their info, ordered by id.

methods.name: ensureCameraPermission
methods.description: Checks and requests camera permission if not granted.

methods.name: ensureMicPermission
methods.description: Checks and requests microphone permission if not granted.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a still JPEG image with optional parameters for quality, device, and orientation, returning a Payload object.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a short video clip with optional audio, duration, and device parameters, returning a FilePayload object.

methods.name: rotateBitmapByExif
methods.description: Rotates a Bitmap according to EXIF orientation info.

methods.name: parseFacing
methods.description: Parses the 'facing' direction parameter from JSON input.

methods.name: parseQuality
methods.description: Parses quality parameter from JSON input.

methods.name: parseMaxWidth
methods.description: Parses maximum width parameter from JSON input.

methods.name: parseDurationMs
methods.description: Parses duration in milliseconds from JSON input.

methods.name: parseDeviceId
methods.description: Parses device ID from JSON input.

methods.name: parseIncludeAudio
methods.description: Parses includeAudio flag from JSON input.

methods.name: resolveCameraSelector
methods.description: Resolves CameraSelector based on device ID or facing direction.

methods.name: cameraDeviceInfoOrNull
methods.description: Creates CameraDeviceInfo object from CameraInfo if possible.

methods.name: cameraIdOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves camera ID string from CameraInfo.
